title: Everyday Phrases — Rehearsing in a Community Choir
title_quote: Good evening, is this the choir room?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎵 實用「業餘合唱團」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Rehearsing in a Community Choir
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「業餘合唱團」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是指揮：社區合唱團練唱：到活動中心報到拿譜、一起暖嗓，分部練聲時女高音與男低音對拍，合起來唱整首、指揮修細節與結尾，最後排下週曲目、收譜、喝熱茶道別。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Rehearsing in a Community Choir' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A community choir rehearsal: warming up, practising the parts, putting the whole piece together, taking the conductor's notes, and ending with tea and goodbyes. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good evening, is this the choir room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈivnɪŋ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈkwaɪr rum?/
dialogue.zh: 晚上好，這裡是合唱室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please come in and sign here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz kʌm ɪn ænd saɪn hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I am here for rehearsal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, I have your name.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I leave my coat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are hooks behind the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get my music sheet now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt maɪ ˈmjuzɪk ʃit naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, they are in this box.
dialogue.zh: 當然，它們在這個箱子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which folder has my part?
dialogue.zh: 哪個資料夾是我的聲部？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green one says alto.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sing alto, is that right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you sat with altos last time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju sæt wɪð ˈæltoʊz læst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 對，你上次坐在女低音那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many songs are we singing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have a few songs tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is our conductor this year?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miss Lin teaches the Tuesday group.
dialogue.zh: 林老師帶星期二這一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Miss Lin already in the hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz mɪs lɪn ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn ðə hɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 林老師已經在廳裡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is warming up the piano.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we start with a warm up?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɑrt wɪð ə wɔrm ʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, breathing first, then singing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we hum before singing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Humming wakes up your sleepy voice.
dialogue.zh: 哼唱能喚醒還沒醒的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I borrow a pencil for notes?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈbɑroʊ ə ˈpɛnsəl fɔr noʊts?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以借一支筆記重點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one from the front table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這個位子有人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you can sit beside me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to meet you, I am Wei.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu mit ju aɪ æm weɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am Anna, my first rehearsal.
dialogue.zh: 我是安娜，第一次來排練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we sit near the piano?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the sound is clearer.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，那裡聲音比較清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put your phone on silent.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already done, it is in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi dʌn ɪt ɪz ɪn maɪ bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is your music folder, Anna.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, it looks brand new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these notes for the high part?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz noʊts fɔr ðə haɪ pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 這些音符是高音部的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those lines are for the sopranos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the rehearsal finish tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around nine, if we stay focused.
dialogue.zh: 大概九點，如果我們專心的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring water for my throat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ ˈwɔtər fɔr maɪ θroʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, warm water helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us stand and stretch our shoulders.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stænd ænd strɛtʃ aʊr ˈʃoʊldərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shoulders are always so tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you show me the breathing exercise?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈbriðɪŋ ˈɛksərsaɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以示範呼吸練習嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe in slowly, then let it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ɪn ˈsloʊli ðɛn lɛt ɪt aʊt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my posture good like this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straighten your back and relax your knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstreɪtən jʊr bæk ænd rɪˈlæks jʊr niz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put my hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the folder, not your sleeves.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That warm up felt strange at first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɔrm ʌp fɛlt streɪndʒ æt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 這個暖嗓一開始好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gets easier after a few rounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɛts ˈiziər ˈæftər ə fju raʊndz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the choir meet every Tuesday?
dialogue.zh: 合唱團每個星期二都練嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We meet every Tuesday evening.
dialogue.zh: 我們每個星期二晚上都練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat feels a little dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sip some water before we begin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These harmonies look quite hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start slowly, the notes will come.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part do you usually sing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sing the low bass line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You have a very deep voice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I practice every day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sing in a choir before?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju sɪŋ ɪn ə ˈkwaɪr bɪˈfɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only in school, many years ago.
dialogue.zh: 只有學校唱過，好多年前了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long has Miss Lin taught here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæz mɪs lɪn tɔt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 林老師在這裡教多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe ten years, she never says.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who keeps the piano in tune?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A man comes every second month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it warm enough in here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, my fingers are still cold.
dialogue.zh: 快了，我的手指還有點冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I open the small window?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better ask Miss Lin first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I stand for alto?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the left side, near me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we start with humming?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the pianist, she is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fɔr ðə ˈpiənɪst ʃi ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 等一下鋼琴手，她快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please hum gently, not too loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My lips are buzzing a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this note sound too high?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, try singing it softer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us breathe together one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs brið təˈɡɛðər wʌn mɔr taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In through the nose, out slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That felt better than the first try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɛlt ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə fɜrst traɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your voice is opening up nicely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still forget to breathe deeply.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one hand on your stomach.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is the break tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half past eight, after the second song.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf pæst eɪt ˈæftər ðə ˈsɛkənd sɔŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will there be tea in the hallway?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðɛr bi ti ɪn ðə ˈhɔlweɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone always brings a big pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we singing the folk song first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈsɪŋɪŋ ðə foʊk sɔŋ fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the easiest one to begin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ði ˈiziəst wʌn tu bɪˈɡɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you pass me the folder, Ben?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju pæs mi ðə ˈfoʊldər bɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 班，可以把譜夾遞給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, careful with the pages.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ˈkɛrfəl wɪð ðə ˈpeɪdʒɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room has lovely high ceilings.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sound travels well in here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, everyone is finally sitting down.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，大家終於坐好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our conductor is raising her hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we hum the same note together.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi hʌm ðə seɪm noʊt təˈɡɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們一起哼同一個音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen to the piano and follow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my voice feels warm now.
dialogue.zh: 很好，我的聲音現在暖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, let us start the song.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu lɛt ʌs stɑrt ðə sɔŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's start with the sopranos today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we are all ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How high can you sing today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not very high, my throat hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should warm up the lower voices.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʊd wɔrm ʌp ðə ˈloʊər ˈvɔɪsɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basses are already humming softly.
dialogue.zh: 男低音已經在輕輕哼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear the piano clearly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but the room is loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the alto part sound right?
dialogue.zh: 女低音這段聽起來對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sounds a little too low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That note was a bit sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I will sing it softer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part do you sing here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sing the second soprano line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's try the whole phrase again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not so fast, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the tenors behind the beat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they come in too late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we hear the two parts together?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi hɪr ðə tu pɑrts təˈɡɛðər?/
dialogue.zh: 可以聽兩個聲部一起唱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the piano will play both.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are singing a little too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈsɪŋɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl tu fæst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, the piano moves me along.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，鋼琴讓我跟著往前跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please watch the conductor more closely.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep my eyes on her.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip maɪ aɪz ɑn hɜr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that the right starting note?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it was a step lower.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sopranos come in on this beat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə səˈprænoʊz kʌm ɪn ɑn ðɪs bit/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the basses answer after that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that chord so strange?
dialogue.zh: 那個和絃為什麼這麼怪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because one voice is off pitch.
dialogue.zh: 因為有一個聲部走音了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold that note longer?
dialogue.zh: 那個音可以拉長一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if I take a breath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we breathe in this line?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi brið ɪn ðɪs laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 這一句我們在哪裡換氣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After the word morning, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想是在 morning 這個字之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That harmony sounded very warm.
dialogue.zh: 那個和聲聽起來很溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lower voices helped a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's go back to the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a good idea now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sing this part alone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, two of us sing together.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我們兩個人一起唱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we slow the tempo down?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把速度放慢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will play it slower.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is singing that high note?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first soprano on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your part is easy to follow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I marked every entrance clearly.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我把每個進點都標清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you standing too close to me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈstændɪŋ tu kloʊs tu mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I will step back now.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我現在往後退一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That run of notes needs practice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's repeat it five more times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second verse is still too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd vɜrs ɪz stɪl tu fæst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will count the beats out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kaʊnt ðə bits aʊt laʊd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody in the back is flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It may be the second bass line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪ bi ðə ˈsɛkənd beɪs laɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you sing this line alone?
dialogue.zh: 你可以單獨唱這一句嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but my voice is tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's clap the rhythm before singing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, my timing is weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That ending was not together.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stopped at different times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which note should I hold longest?
dialogue.zh: 我應該把哪個音拉最長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last one in the phrase.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you keep the pitch steady?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju kip ðə pɪtʃ ˈstɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼讓音準保持穩定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I listen to the piano underneath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the women start this section?
dialogue.zh: 這一段是女生先開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then the men answer softly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your breathing is very noisy today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I am a little nervous.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ aɪ æm ə ˈlɪtəl ˈnɜrvəs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we hear the basses once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi hɪr ðə ˈbeɪsɪz wʌns mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 男低音可以再唱一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we will sing it louder.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們會唱大聲一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That phrase sounds better now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slower tempo really helps us.
dialogue.zh: 慢一點的速度真的幫了我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready for the next part?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈrɛdi fɔr ðə nɛkst pɑrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One moment, I need water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who sings the low notes here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basses on the right side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's sing the two parts together.
dialogue.zh: 我們把兩個聲部一起唱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready when you are, conductor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That note is still a bit high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt noʊt ɪz stɪl ə bɪt haɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will try to relax my jaw.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl traɪ tu rɪˈlæks maɪ dʒɔ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the harmony feel right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one voice is too loud.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，有一個聲部太大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please mark where you breathe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I marked two places with pencil.
dialogue.zh: 我用鉛筆標了兩個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was much better this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We kept the beat together well.
dialogue.zh: 我們把拍子保持得很整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hear the other voices?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but they sing quite fast.
dialogue.zh: 聽得到，但他們唱得相當快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The conductor wants a softer sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will sing this part quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does this section feel slow?
dialogue.zh: 這一段為什麼感覺很慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because the basses drag the beat.
dialogue.zh: 因為男低音把拍子拖慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we singing the right words?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the second line is different.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That run needs more practice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's sing it slowly one time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your high note sounded very clear.
dialogue.zh: 你的高音聽起來很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, the warm up helped me.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðə wɔrm ʌp hɛlpt mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we start from the top?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from the very first bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we sing the whole song now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi sɪŋ ðə hoʊl sɔŋ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在可以唱整首了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please start from the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we stand for the opening?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi stænd fɔr ði ˈoʊpənɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand in two rows near the piano.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ɪn tu roʊz nɪr ðə piˈæno./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who gives the first note tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pianist gives it on the piano.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpiənɪst ɡɪvz ɪt ɑn ðə piˈæno./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the tempo slower tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚的速度為什麼慢一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The conductor wants a calmer opening.
dialogue.zh: 指揮想要更平靜的開頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How loud should the first line be?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ laʊd ʃʊd ðə fɜrst laɪn bi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Softly at first, then a little louder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔftli æt fɜrst ðɛn ə ˈlɪtəl ˈlaʊdər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we watch the conductor's right hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi wɑtʃ ðə kənˈdʌktərz raɪt hænd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該看指揮的右手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch both hands and keep breathing.
dialogue.zh: 兩隻手都看，並持續呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we try the whole song once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi traɪ ðə hoʊl sɔŋ wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以整首試一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and please do not stop.
dialogue.zh: 可以，而且請不要停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we sing the second verse too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi sɪŋ ðə ˈsɛkənd vɜrs tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every verse is in the song.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈɛvri vɜrs ɪz ɪn ðə sɔŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens at the middle section?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tenors take the melody there.
dialogue.zh: 男高音在那裡唱主旋律。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part needs the most practice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ending needs a lot of practice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛndɪŋ nidz ə lɑt əv ˈpræktɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we sing it a little slower?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi sɪŋ ɪt ə ˈlɪtəl ˈsloʊər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, slower helps us hear each other.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsloʊər hɛlps ʌs hɪr itʃ ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，慢一點能聽見彼此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the high note still too hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə haɪ noʊt stɪl tu hɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is easier when we breathe first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈiziər wɛn wi brið fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the conductor want the ending?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn dʌz ðə kənˈdʌktər wɑnt ði ˈɛndɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wants a long soft ending.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we holding the last note?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hold it for four beats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we count the four beats?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi kaʊnt ðə fɔr bits?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count with the conductor's left hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the piano play our notes first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə piˈæno pleɪ aʊər noʊts fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 鋼琴可以先彈我們的音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, listen once and then sing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we lose the beat again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi luz ðə bit əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我們又跟不上拍子呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep going and trust the conductor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do the altos sing under us?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ði ˈæltoʊz sɪŋ ˈʌndər ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼女低音在我們下面唱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their line fills the space between.
dialogue.zh: 他們的聲部填滿中間的空隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we look at the conductor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look up at the hard parts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we mark the breathing spots?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mark them before the long phrases.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs mɑrk ðɛm bɪˈfɔr ðə lɔŋ ˈfreɪzɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we breathe together at the comma?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi brið təˈɡɛðər æt ðə ˈkɑmə?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在逗號處一起呼吸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one quiet breath together.
dialogue.zh: 對，一起安靜地吸一口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which words should sound the clearest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The words at the end of phrases.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɜrdz æt ði ɛnd əv ˈfreɪzɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the tenors sing that line softer?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə ˈtɛnərz sɪŋ ðæt laɪn ˈsɔftər?/
dialogue.zh: 男高音那句可以唱柔一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but please keep the rhythm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the last chord in tune now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə læst kɔrd ɪn tun naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個和絃現在準了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, the basses are still flat.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，男低音還偏低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times do we repeat it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni taɪmz du wi rɪˈpit ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times, then we finish softly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we run it once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and keep the tempo steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the balance between parts?
dialogue.zh: 各聲部之間的平衡如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sopranos are still too loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch my hand for the final cut.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ maɪ hænd fɔr ðə ˈfaɪnəl kʌt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will watch and stop together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tempo too fast for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈtɛmpoʊ tu fæst fɔr ju?/
dialogue.zh: 這個速度對你來說太快嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it feels comfortable for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we slow down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the last two bars only.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the basses need a breath there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈbeɪsɪz nid ə brɛθ ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 男低音那裡需要換氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a quick breath before that note.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə kwɪk brɛθ bɪˈfɔr ðæt noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 要，那個音之前快速吸一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did the final chord go flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dɪd ðə ˈfaɪnəl kɔrd ɡoʊ flæt?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個和絃為什麼偏低？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because we were running out of air.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈkɔz wi wɜr ˈrʌnɪŋ aʊt əv ɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we hold the last note longer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi hoʊld ðə læst noʊt ˈlɔŋɡər?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個音要拉更長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, longer and much softer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us fix that rhythm again.
dialogue.zh: 我們再把那個節奏修一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, we rushed that part.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，那部分我們趕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which line needs a softer ending?
dialogue.zh: 哪一句需要更柔的結尾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last line of the chorus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the altos comfortable with that note?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ði ˈæltoʊz ˈkʌmfərtəbəl wɪð ðæt noʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 女低音唱那個音舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it sits well for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show us the beat before we start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ʌs ðə bit bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 開始前給我們看一下拍子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, and then breathe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the tenors sing their line softer?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə ˈtɛnərz sɪŋ ðɛr laɪn ˈsɔftər?/
dialogue.zh: 男高音那句可以唱柔一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can, but we need air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the piano cover our voices?
dialogue.zh: 鋼琴蓋過我們的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, please sing a bit louder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl pliz sɪŋ ə bɪt ˈlaʊdər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is conducting the last page?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our conductor, she leads the ending.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we breathe together at the bar?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi brið təˈɡɛðər æt ðə bɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要在小節線一起吸氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, together, so the ending stays clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs təˈɡɛðər soʊ ði ˈɛndɪŋ steɪz klin./
dialogue.zh: 對，一起，這樣結尾才乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the ending with the full choir.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ˈɛndɪŋ wɪð ðə fʊl ˈkwaɪər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are ready for the final run.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ˈrɛdi fɔr ðə ˈfaɪnəl rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我們準備好最後一次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was much better, everyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, it felt much calmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once more, from the quiet part.
dialogue.zh: 再來一次，從小聲的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the quiet part, slowly please.
dialogue.zh: 從小聲的部分，請慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark your breath before the long phrase.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑrk jʊr brɛθ bɪˈfɔr ðə lɔŋ freɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I marked mine with a pencil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need more air here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡我們需要更多氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, more air for the last note.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs mɔr ɛr fɔr ðə læst noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 要，最後一個音需要更多氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we hear the whole choir again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi hɪr ðə hoʊl ˈkwaɪər əˈɡɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one more time from the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn mɔr taɪm frʌm ðə tɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was the blend in that chord?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wʌz ðə blɛnd ɪn ðæt kɔrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, but the ending felt short.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，但結尾感覺太短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the last note soft and long.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə læst noʊt sɔft ænd lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 最後一個音保持輕而長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft and long, we understand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good work, we are almost ready.
dialogue.zh: 做得好，我們差不多準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost ready for the concert night.
dialogue.zh: 差不多可以上演唱會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are we singing next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are singing the spring song.
dialogue.zh: 我們要唱那首春天的歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which song should we practice next?
dialogue.zh: 我們接下來該練哪一首？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us start with the slow one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt wɪð ðə sloʊ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我們先從慢的那首開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sing the new piece again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi sɪŋ ðə nu pis əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再唱一次新曲子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can try it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who chose the song for Sunday?
dialogue.zh: 星期天那首曲子是誰選的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The conductor chose it last month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have we got the music yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put the copies in your folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt ðə ˈkɑpiz ɪn jʊr ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 我把影本放進你的資料夾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many songs do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need three songs for the show.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid θri sɔŋz fɔr ðə ʃoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is our next rehearsal night?
dialogue.zh: 我們下次練唱是哪天晚上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on Thursday at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put my sheet music?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju pʊt maɪ ʃit ˈmjuzɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 你把我的譜放到哪裡了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your sheets are on the piano.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these the parts for next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz ðə pɑrts fɔr nɛkst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 這些是下週要用的聲部譜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, those are the alto parts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please give me the second page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, right on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this copy yours or mine?
dialogue.zh: 這份譜是你的還是我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, mine has a blue cover.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我的封面是藍色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we change the song list?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du wi tʃeɪndʒ ðə sɔŋ lɪst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because the tenor is not ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you bring the extra copies?
dialogue.zh: 你可以帶多印的譜來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will bring them all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us keep the old song too.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs kip ði oʊld sɔŋ tu./
dialogue.zh: 我們也把那首舊歌留著吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is fine with the group.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part is the hardest one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ending is the hardest part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the green folder?
dialogue.zh: 你要那個綠色的資料夾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the green one is mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I leave the music?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it in the front box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we sing the fast one first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi sɪŋ ðə fæst wʌn fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要先唱快的那首嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, let us warm up first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who has the list of songs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia has it in her bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the new song easy to learn?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə nu sɔŋ ˈizi tu lɜrn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is easy after a while.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take my copy home?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把我的譜帶回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but bring it back Friday.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但星期五要帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do we finish tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We finish around nine tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we sing the same song Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi sɪŋ ðə seɪm sɔŋ ˈsʌndeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 星期天我們唱同一首歌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we sing a different one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you free to practice Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am free in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the new piece?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about four minutes long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like some hot tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tea sounds good tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tea still warm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I just poured it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take milk in tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I like it plain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose cup is on the table?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That cup belongs to Sam.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have a small biscuit?
dialogue.zh: 我可以吃一塊小餅乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the box is over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you buy this tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bought it near the market.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the lovely evening tonight.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今晚這麼美好的時光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for singing so well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you come again next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will be there early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you leaving so soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my sister waits outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we clean the room now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在要收拾房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us stack the chairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I help you wash the cups?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hɛlp ju wɑʃ ðə kʌps?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would really help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you get home tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I walk home with my sister.
dialogue.zh: 我和我妹妹一起走回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will grab my coat now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is on the chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we share a taxi home?
dialogue.zh: 我們要一起搭計程車回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, my sister walks with me.
dialogue.zh: 不了，我妹妹陪我走回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is your coat and bag?
dialogue.zh: 你的外套和袋子在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My coat is behind the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it cold outside right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wear your warm scarf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please say hello to your family.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, and thanks again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you think of tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think we sang quite well.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得我們唱得相當好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we meet a little earlier?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以早一點碰面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us meet at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you still got my umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is by the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take care on your way home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, you too, good night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your sister outside now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she is by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we all ready to go home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ɔl ˈrɛdi tu ɡoʊ hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 我們都準備好回家了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we are all very tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is locking the front door?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The conductor locks it every night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodbye, and thank you very much.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodbye, take care and rest well.

issues.note: 警告級（非 error）：177 由 char_b 說「Ready when you are, conductor.」，254 由 char_a 說「Watch my hand for the final cut.」，兩把聲音在團員／指揮之間擺動；本格式以朗讀聲部計，且未出現「同一把聲音扮指揮、緊接著又把指揮當第三人稱談論」的禁用型態。
警告級（非 error）：278 問「Who is conducting the last page?」，279 答「Our conductor, she leads the ending.」屬同義重述、無新資訊；全篇僅此一處問答空轉。
警告級（非 error）：391 已道「good night」，392–397 又續談（妹妹在不在、誰鎖門），到 398–399 才正式告別；屬自然離場拖延，無狀態矛盾，非 error 級。
警告級（非 error）：027 自報「I am Anna, my first rehearsal.」，032 被稱 Anna，090 又稱 Ben，337／357 出現 Mia／Sam；皆屬聲位切換下的裝飾性人名，非同一人前後硬矛盾。
警告級（非 error）：「Welcome, I have your name.」語意偏模糊，母語者多說 I have your name on the list.，仍可理解。
警告級（非 error）：「my music sheet」為單數卻接 they are in this box，數不一致；慣用語為 sheet music（314 已用對）。另 308「Have we got the music yet?」偏英式，美式多作 Do we have…。
警告級（非 error）：機器信號的譯文夾英文 'morning'（「我想是在 morning 這個字之後」）；原句本就在引述英文歌詞用字，可接受。
警告級（非 error）：244/245 與 274/275 都是「請 tenors 唱輕一點」，近乎同一對；且 100–299 多組走音／太快／太大聲修正高度相似，b 句約 30 條以 Yes 開頭、a 句大量 Can/Could/Should we 起句。

review.summary_zh: 第 2 輪修正已逐處核實：003、026、046 換句避開撞句，071 不再把 Anna 當第三人稱，028／072／250／376 已改 Should we，374／375 改為拿外套、不再於道晚安後續談。全篇報到拿譜→暖嗓→分部對拍修細節→合練整首→排下週曲目收譜→喝茶道別推進完整，b 皆有實詞回應，未見 error 級問題；C 項依機器證據（SUSPECT 0、token 對齊通過）給滿分，僅餘 8 條已具名的警告級殘留，故予 APPROVED。
